newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Lenenergo shares rise 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia Lenenergo shares rise 18 pct.

text.p: Shares in Russian regional utility Lenenergo had jumped 18 percent by 1130 GMT on Tuesday to $0.850 from $0.720 at Monday's close.
Turnover had reached 401,000 shares on the Russian Trading System (RTS).
"There is a lack of shares. It is based on the flow of funds," Alexei Genkin, deputy director of international sales at Alfa Bank, said.
Lenenergo prefs had risen to $0.590 from $0.550 on almost 300,000 shares turnover.
The RTS index had risen to a record 322.08 by 0900 GMT from 320.34 at Monday's close.
